negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a dedicated, publicly documented API endpoint at Opendatabot or Vkursi that filters specifically for payment institutions / payment service providers as a class (as opposed to generic USREOU + KVED filtering).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for Opendatabot/Vkursi API and payment-company data returned only generic company-lookup and financial-statement endpoints; sector filtering appears to be user-side via KVED codes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment-sector actor enumeration will have to be built by joining aggregator data to the NBU's own register of payment infrastructure participants rather than obtained ready-made from an aggregator.

negative_findings.description: The state of ЄДР bulk open data is in flux: coverage indicates access was restricted from 2022 and reported restored in January 2026, with publication on data.gov.ua described as still in progress and defence/strategic entities withheld.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset page exists on data.gov.ua; multiple secondary sources describe restoration and weekly updates, but actual current file availability was not fetched or confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The whole cell's cheapest bulk channel may be partially available; the pipeline must degrade gracefully to commercial aggregators (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity, Vkursi) when the bulk dump is incomplete.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language equivalent found for a free, open, bulk-downloadable register of beneficial owners specifically for banks; UBO data appears only inside the ЄДР and inside paid aggregator dossiers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for кінцевий бенефіціарний власник in the context of banks returned aggregator dossier pages and policy news, not a standalone open UBO dataset for the financial sector.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership tracking for Ukrainian banks will depend on ЄДР extracts plus NBU-published ownership structures rather than a purpose-built open UBO feed.

negative_findings.description: The NAIS (ДП «НАІС») open-data publication path was named in secondary coverage but its exact download URL was not located; the candidate is recorded at the organisation's root domain only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Secondary sources say ЄДР open data is published on the Ministry of Justice site and by SE NAIS; no direct file listing URL was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A second, official mirror of the ЄДР bulk data would materially de-risk the pipeline; the exact path still needs to be found.

negative_findings.description: All four commercial aggregators in this cell (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity Project, Vkursi) gate financial statements and bulk/API access behind paid tariffs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pricing pages exist for Opendatabot and Clarity Project; Vkursi and YouControl advertise API and subscription tiers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The archive value of this cell — recovering filings after issuer sites go offline — is real but requires budget and licence terms permitting analytical reuse; scraping would breach ToS.

brief: Ukraine's register-and-aggregator layer is unusually rich: a statutory core (ЄДР via usr.minjust.gov.ua free search plus a bulk open dataset on data.gov.ua whose access was restricted in 2022 and reported restored in January 2026) sits under four mature commercial aggregators — YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity Project and Vkursi — each of which normalises registration data, ownership and financial-statement indicators keyed on EDRPOU and each of which can enumerate every bank and payment company by KVED 64.x/66.x. For actual filings rather than indicators, SMIDA/stockmarket.gov.ua is the statutory disclosure archive holding issuer annual reports (banks file on a bank-specific form, deadline 30 April), and GLEIF's LEI Search plus Golden Copy/Level 2 files provide the international identity and group-ownership backbone for UA financial entities. The binding constraints are commercial: financial statements and APIs on all four aggregators are paywalled, so the wartime archive value of this cell depends on licence terms, not on technical access. Highest-leverage next step is joining the ЄДР bulk dataset with NBU registers and GLEIF UA records into one canonical EDRPOU+LEI entity table, then testing which aggregators retain original documents rather than only derived fields.
